diagrams.title: BDD — Core blocks with ports (public)
IBD — typed item flows (public)

flowchart LR
 U[User] -->|HTTP JSON IF-002| UI[Web UI]
 UI -->|API JSON| API[Core API]
 API -->|context+message| AR[Agent Runtime]
 AR -->|ObserveEvent| EC[Emotional Continuity]
 AR -->|Retrieve/Store| MEM[Memory]

diagrams.title: User conversation lifecycle
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
 participant U as User
 participant UI as Web UI
 participant AR as Agent Runtime
 participant MR as Model Router
 participant M as Model
 participant MEM as Memory
 participant EC as Emotional Continuity
 U->>UI: message
 UI->>AR: request
 AR->>EC: observe_message
 AR->>MEM: retrieve context
 AR->>MR: route capability
 MR->>M: inference
 M-->>AR: completion
 AR->>MEM: store
 AR-->>UI: response
 UI-->>U: render

diagrams.title: REX lifecycle
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
 participant D as Detect
 participant P as Propose
 participant R as Review/Authorize
 participant E as Execute
 participant V as Verify
 participant C as Close
 participant L as Learn
 D->>P: draft proposal
 P->>R: approval gate
 R->>E: approved item
 E->>V: done + evidence
 V->>C: verified or failed
 C->>L: outcome signal

diagrams.title: Installation activity
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
 A[Download Setup] --> B[Prerequisite detection]
 B --> C[Dependency installation]
 C --> D{WSL reboot needed?}
 D -->|yes| E[Reboot]
 E --> F[Resume Setup]
 D -->|no| F
 F --> G[Configuration]
 G --> H[Model / runtime setup]
 H --> I[Service setup]
 I --> J[Health check]
 J --> K[Completion]

diagrams.title: Failure / recovery activity
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
 A[Detect failure] --> B[Classify]
 B --> C[Recovery action]
 C --> D[Retest / health check]
 D -->|success| E[Resume operations]
 D -->|fail| F[Escalate / document]

diagrams.title: Agent request handling
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
 A[Receive request] --> B[Auth / login gate]
 B --> C[Assemble context]
 C --> D[Apply continuity / relationships]
 D --> E[Route model]
 E --> F[Execute tools if needed]
 F --> G[Generate response]
 G --> H[Persist + return]

diagrams.title: REX proposal / item states (conceptual)
diagrams.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
 [*] --> Draft
 Draft --> Approved
 Draft --> Rejected
 Approved --> Executing
 Executing --> Done
 Executing --> Failed
 Done --> Verifying
 Verifying --> Verified
 Verifying --> VerifyFailed
 Verifying --> Unverifiable
 Verified --> Closed
 Failed --> Closed
 Rejected --> [*]
 Closed --> [*]

diagrams.title: Emotional stage labels
diagrams.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
 [*] --> calm
 calm --> low
 low --> moderate
 moderate --> jealous_hurt
 moderate --> defensive
 defensive --> high_anger
 high_anger --> disengaged
 jealous_hurt --> moderate: repair
 defensive --> moderate: repair
 disengaged --> moderate: genuine_repair

diagrams.title: V-Model mapping
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
 UN[User Needs] --- VAL[Validation]
 SR[System Requirements] --- SV[System Verification]
 AR[Architecture] --- IV[Integration Verification]
 DD[Detailed Design] --- UV[Unit Verification]
 IMP[Implementation] --- INT[Integration]
 UN --> SR --> AR --> DD --> IMP --> INT
 INT --> UV --> IV --> SV --> VAL
